q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a college hostel per student?
title: College hostel carbon per student
short: Add hostel electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, mess LPG at 2.98 kg per kg, and generator diesel at 2.68 kg per litre, then divide by resident students. Sub-meter the hostel if it shares a campus supply, or label the split an estimate.

ul: Electricity for rooms, fans, ACs, water heaters and pumps.

p: If the hostel shares a meter with the campus, split by sub-meter readings, or by connected load and hours as a labelled estimate.
Divide by resident students per month. Food bought for the mess is Scope 3 and can be added later from purchase records.

example.title: Worked example: 500-student hostel (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 33,674 / 500 = 67.3 kg CO2 per student a month
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and occupancy.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
